players.product: NVLink copper cable cartridges, high-speed connectors and cable assemblies for NVL72 racks

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 174.50 billion, up 40.16% YoY (RMB 124.50 billion in H1 2025), attributed to business combinations and higher product shipments; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 7.84 billion, up 18.04%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 5.96 billion, up 6.47%. The company says currency moves caused an exchange loss of about RMB 19.86 hundred million on its foreign-currency asset and liability exposure, while RMB 12.97 hundred million of FX risk-management gains were booked as non-recurring items, so the recurring profit does not show the full hedging effect. Gross margin 11.78%, up 0.17 points, mainly because communications and data center and automotive electronics, which carry above-average margins, kept growing fast. Operating cash flow -RMB 2.45 billion, mainly on payments of supplier invoices falling due.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 174.50 billion (+40.16%); net profit RMB 7.84 billion (+18.04%); gross margin 11.78%

quarterly_data.signal: Revenue by segment, H1 2026 (half-year report): communications and data center RMB 16.61 billion, up 49.66%, 9.52% of revenue (8.91% a year earlier), gross margin 17.29% (-2.48 points; cost of sales +54.27%); consumer electronics RMB 122.48 billion, up 19.27%, 70.18% of revenue, gross margin 10.25% (-0.13 points); automotive electronics RMB 32.39 billion, up 274.10%, 18.56% of revenue, gross margin 14.14% - the company says the Leoni integration continues and its overall operating performance beat expectations; other RMB 3.03 billion (+47.08%). Overseas sales RMB 146.06 billion, 83.70% of revenue (+38.15%); domestic sales RMB 28.45 billion (+51.49%).
quarterly_data.figure: communications and data center RMB 16.61 billion (+49.66%), gross margin 17.29%

quarterly_data.signal: High-speed copper interconnect (half-year report): the company is pursuing 224G, 448G and next-generation higher-speed technology around CPC, NPC, Cable Cartridge and high-speed backplane connectors, and is pushing CPC-related products to commercial deployment in H2 2027. It says that beyond North America the China market also offers large opportunities as AI evolves, especially in high-speed copper cables and connectors with high technical barriers and domestic substitution, where the company has gained a significant advantage and 'will achieve high growth over the next three years'.
quarterly_data.figure: CPC-related products targeted for commercial deployment in H2 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Optical interconnect (half-year report): 800G optical modules reached mass-production shipments in H1 2026; in H2 the company plans to complete development, validation and mass-production rollout of what it calls an industry-leading automated process. It is laying out 1.6T, 2.4T and 3.2T LRO and LPO as well as XPO, NPO and CPO, which it expects to reach automated process development and mass production successively in H2 2026 and the next two years.
quarterly_data.figure: 800G optical modules in mass-production shipment in H1 2026; 1.6T/2.4T/3.2T LRO/LPO from H2 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Thermal and power (half-year report): building on liquid-cooling products already in mass production, the company is accelerating product introduction at a core North American customer and expects to reach supplier qualification, small-batch delivery and large-scale mass production in stages in H2 2026 and next year; it is also advancing diamond-copper, microchannel and CDU cooling products, planned for mass production next year and the year after. In power, as AIDC power moves from 12V to 48/50/54V rack-level and 800V high-voltage DC, its DC-DC low-voltage server module power business has achieved scaled mass-production shipments from tertiary to primary power, and it is laying out high-voltage and ultra-high-voltage power solutions for high-power compute over the next two years.
quarterly_data.figure: liquid cooling: North American core customer qualification and small-batch delivery expected H2 2026; DC-DC server module power in volume shipment

quarterly_data.signal: Full-year 2026 outlook (half-year report, company statement): with new products and ODM/JDM projects of core consumer-electronics customers, key communications and data center projects in high-speed electrical connection, optical connection, thermal and power management accelerating into mass production, and new business from the Leoni integration and global automotive customers, the company says its earlier strategic investments are expected to gradually turn into incremental growth momentum in the second half; it will strive for steady growth in scale, better earnings quality and operating performance better than the industry average. No numeric guidance.
R&D (half-year report): R&D investment RMB 6,572,800,944.57 in H1 2026, up 43.09%, on higher staff pay, moulds, materials and certification costs.

Construction in progress and inventory (half-year report): construction in progress RMB 5,206,085,858.83 at 30 June 2026 (RMB 4,290,260,998.33 at end-2025), incl. equipment installation RMB 2,166,627,418.61 (RMB 847,070,694.07). Major projects (cumulative input as share of budget): Changshu Luxshare plant 99.01%; Changshu Luxshare equipment installation 99.74%; Vietnam Likai plant 87.43%; Nghe An equipment installation 92.35%; Nghe An Luxshare phase-2 plant 88.05%; a new Luxshare Precision plant construction project, budget RMB 526,675,528.67, 36.68%. Inventory RMB 50.37 billion (RMB 42.33 billion at end-2025), which the company attributes to business growth and strategic material stocking.
quarterly_data.figure: construction in progress RMB 5,206,085,858.83; inventory RMB 50.37 billion
